repro: Menu > Skills > Hustle (gangster): 'Spin Cycle | +8 max health', 'Fat Envelope | +8 max health' sit in the Money branch; 'Armoured Drones | +5% battle supply' while 'Supply Run | +4 battle helper health'; 'War Room | +6 max energy'. Names come from the ordered name lists at gen_skill_trees.py ~101-103 and effects are dealt round-robin, so they land on the wrong effect.
fix: Reorder the name lists (or give those slots fitting names) so money names land on money effects: e.g. swap so 'Supply Run' = battle supply, 'Armoured Drones' = helper health, health nodes become 'Thick Skin'/'Good Coat', 'War Room' = supply and 'Night Shift' = energy. Renames keep ranks via the generator's 'aka' list. Rerun gen_skill_trees.py.
